description.text: The promos of the Sword & Shield Series, SWSH001 to SWSH307, released from November 2019 to August 2023. The set began with the Galar Collection, out the same day as the Pokémon Sword and Shield games, and the prefix changed from SM to SWSH. Nearly all came in products: collections, blisters, boxes, premium collections, tins and Build & Battle Boxes, some of whose promos also went out through the Pokémon League in early 2023. The series also covered the game's 25th anniversary, with Celebrations products and General Mills cereal mini packs, and the Pokémon GO tie-in products, and closed with the Trainer's Toolkit 2023.

description.text: Given to celebrate the launch of the Pokémon Center online store in the United Kingdom. Residents of the United States, Canada (except Quebec) and the UK could register for a one-time code from 11 July 2022, and every code had been claimed by 14 July; the code added the card to an order of at least $20, C$20 or £20 until the end of 2022, and the first working codes arrived in early August. Numerous copies had already gone out by mistake with Pokémon Center orders in May and June 2021. Its attack Happy Delivery, first seen on Lost Thunder's Delibird, searches the deck for up to two Item cards.

description.text: Julie Hang's Bulbasaur, the United States' first runner-up of the Pokémon Trading Card Game Illustration Contest 2022, made into a card with the two other prize-winning illustrations, Arcanine SWSH304 and Greninja SWSH305. The three came in a sealed pack: people in the United States, Canada (except Quebec) and the UK registered between 19 December 2022 and 12 January 2023 for an emailed code, sent in waves, that added the pack to a Pokémon Center order of at least $30, C$30 or £30 until 30 September 2023. In Japan the same three cards were S-P promos, given in a pack with purchases at Pokémon Centers from 16 December 2022.
